html:
Msiri was a trader from the Nyamwezi of what is now Tanzania who founded the Yeke kingdom at Bunkeya in Katanga in the 1850s and ruled it until he was killed in 1891.

He came to buy copper and ivory and built a state by force and alliance, taking over lands of the Lunda and of Kazembe. He traded copper, ivory and slaves to both coasts.

In 1891 rival expeditions from Leopold II's Congo Free State and Cecil Rhodes raced to win his land. When he refused to accept the Free State flag, a Belgian officer of the Stairs expedition shot him dead on 20 December. Katanga, with its copper, went to the Free State.
